_doc: Curated names OSM lacks (decision 026). `aliases`: another name for the same place; a lookup by it reports that name ("Central Park Reservoir"). `redirects`: a name runners use for a different thing, such as the road beside a running path; a lookup by it reports the place's own name ("West Side Highway" finds the Hudson River Greenway). Each entry names the OSM place exactly; the loader fails if it isn't found. Keep this short: names live here, not in the parse prompt.

aliases.name: Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis Reservoir
aliases.why: What runners call it (parse eval R02); OSM has only the official name.

redirects.name: Hudson River Greenway
redirects.why: Runners name the road; the running path beside it is the greenway (parse eval R03). Moved out of the parse prompt (Jared, 2026-11-06).

redirects.name: East River Greenway
redirects.why: What runners call the East River Greenway (parse eval P49). Moved out of the parse prompt.
